tasks.title: Find your way around
tasks.why: Where everything is, and how to get help on any button.

steps.cap: The top bar: the menu button on the left, your name and rank, the bell for alerts, and sign out on the right.
The menu: every page you may open. Your rank decides which pages show.
The Dashboard: today’s work first. Press a box to jump to that list.
Hold the mouse on any button, tab or column for a short explainer. Turn them FAST or OFF in Settings > Appearance.

tasks.title: Register a new project
tasks.why: Enter a new job: who pays, where the land is, the stages and the money.

steps.cap: New Project. Pick the project type first. The index number is given by the app.
Clients: the people who pay. Type the NIN first — a person already saved is filled in for you.
Location: district down to village, and the size in hectares (digits only).
Stages: the steps of the work. The usual list is ready; tick what is already done.
Financials: invoice number, contract number and total cost. Without all three the project is saved as Pending.
Documents: add scans and choose their type. PDF, photos, Word and Excel are accepted.
Press SAVE. A missing box is marked in red and the page takes you straight to it.

tasks.title: Find a project and open its folder
tasks.why: Every project lives in its folder: details, stages, money, documents and notes.

steps.cap: Project Ledger: type any part of a name, phone, plot, NIN or index in the search box.
The tabs narrow the list: no title details yet, legacy, receivables, critical, problem, pending.
Press a row to open that project’s folder.
The folder title: PLOT and its number (or PROJECT and the index). Under it: type, status and what the project is waiting for.
The folder tabs: Overview, Financials, People, Documents, Notes.

tasks.title: Tick a stage and attach its document
tasks.why: Keep the work up to date; every tick is saved with your name and the date.

steps.cap: On the Overview tab, the Stage checklist shows every step and how many are done.
Tick a stage when it is done. It saves the moment you click it.
The paperclip attaches that stage’s document (it is filed in Documents under the stage).

tasks.title: Write a note and set a follow-up
tasks.why: What happened, what was agreed, what comes next — the office remembers it for you.

steps.cap: Notes tab: everything that happened on this project — notes, decisions, money, events and calls.
Press ADD NOTE. Pick a topic, write the note, and choose a follow-up day if needed.
On the follow-up day the bell reminds the office. Pin a note to keep it on top (the bell tells the office too).

tasks.title: Log a recovery call
tasks.why: Call clients who owe; every call is counted and the queue sorts itself.

steps.cap: Recovery: the clients to call now. The tabs show who was contacted, missed, needs a site visit or is resting.
Open a client and press CALL LOG.
Pick what happened (answered, not picking up ...), add a short note or a promise date, then save. The history is underneath.

tasks.title: Record a payment
tasks.why: Money in: the balance, receipts and reports all follow.

steps.cap: Folder > Financials: press RECORD PAYMENT.
Enter the amount, how it was paid (Office, Mobile Money, Bank, Other), who paid, and attach the receipt. Then save.
Every payment is listed in Payment History. A mistake is REVERSED (never deleted) and the reason is kept.

tasks.title: Log an expense
tasks.why: Money out of the office, in two taps.

steps.cap: Expenses: tap a category to log money spent. Anything else goes under OTHER.
Entries can be corrected for 24 hours. Deleting asks why, and the reason is kept.

tasks.title: Check the payments
tasks.why: See every payment line, find missing receipts.

steps.cap: Payments: search by project, client, phone, amount or reference.
Filter by dates, missing receipt, and how it was paid.
Press a line to open its project. The receipt button opens the receipt.

tasks.title: Run a report and download the PDF
tasks.why: Numbers for meetings, in the company colours.

steps.cap: Reports: pick the data at the top (Projects, Clients, Payments, Expenses, Company) and the period.
Pick a ready report in the catalogue and press Use This Report.
Choose one or more charts, then download the CSV (for Excel) or the PDF document.

tasks.title: Receivables and storage fees
tasks.why: Long-owing projects and the storage fees of kept titles.

steps.cap: Ledger > Receivables: projects owing for a long time. Storage fees grow every 30 days.
In a folder, Financials holds the fee buttons: rate, pause, reduce, set aside, waive or add to the cost. Each one asks why.

tasks.title: Staff and settings
tasks.why: Add staff, reset a key, and set how the app looks for you.

steps.cap: Settings > Staff: add a person and give them a rank. They get a temporary key and choose their own at first sign-in.
Settings > Appearance: theme, size, explainers, animation — saved for you on this device.

tasks.title: Enter a project from the field
tasks.why: Field staff enter the land and the people; the office adds the money.

steps.cap: New Project: enter the type, clients, owners, neighbours, location and stages. No money boxes for field staff.
Press SAVE. The entry waits as Pending until the office adds the invoice, contract and price.
My Entries: your entries and whether the office has started them.
